Definition
[slice representation]

Source: petersen:page-0226 ↗ cor:pet-ch5-proper-action-orbit-embedding The slice representation of a proper isometric action $H\times M\to M$ at $p$ is the linear representation $H_p\times T_p^\perp Hp\to T_p^\perp Hp$, $(h,v)\mapsto Dh|_p(v)$. Letting $H_p$ act on $H$ on the right, it also acts on $H\times T_p^\perp Hp$, and by subsection 6.4 the quotient $H\times _{H_p}T_p^\perp Hp$ has a natural manifold structure.
